analysis: The only change in this file is at line 129 of EngineV2VisionRoutingTests.swift. A test-only stub `VisionStubLanguageModel.prepare` signature is updated to the new `LanguageModel` protocol (`state: LMOutput.State?, prefill: PrefillParameters` replaces `windowSize`). The stub is never forward-passed and exists only to build a `ModelContainer` in tests. The supplied units are unchanged base text of the same test file (lines 680-1695), which includes the call-site context for the stub. They cover vision routing, reservation release, refusal telemetry, and status mapping (400/499/503). The supplied text shows no production code, wire protocol, key custody, attestation, encryption, or prefix-cache storage path (T-041/TB-007) being altered. The change does not weaken any listed threat mitigation. The tests assert fail-closed behavior: no legacy fallback for media, reservations released, and client errors mapped to 4xx. This file is the only one in scope. The production-side change that motivated the protocol signature update (the `LanguageModel.prepare` protocol with `PrefillParameters`) was not supplied. A reviewer should check that change separately for effects on prefill and KV handling. No finding is made from this test-only diff.
